in_sanskrit.name: Kavisha
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Desire, Wish, Longing
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Kavisha एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Kavisha is derived from the Sanskrit word 'kavishat', which means 'desiring', 'wishing', or 'longing for'. In Hindu mythology, the goddess Saraswati, the goddess of knowledge and wisdom, is often referred to as 'Kavishati', meaning 'desiring knowledge'. Thus, the name Kavisha embodies the spirit of pursuing knowledge and wisdom with strong desire and passion.
